decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Heritage statement, Received 20/11/18. Design and access statement, unnumbered block plan, unnumbered location plan, Unnumbered existing plans, unnumbered proposed plans for next three years, unnumbered proposed plans after three years. Received 06/11/18.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the boundary treatment hereby permitted shall match those stated within the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The temporary fencing hereby approved, as indicated on drawing titled 'scheme 2 - proposal for next 3 years' shall be removed no later than 3 years after commencement of development.
description: Replacing the front gates with an electric folding wooden gate, and setting a temporary (for 3 years) wooden fence on the gate and the existing brick wall at the front of the property. In the course of that, removing the pillar that separates the present pedestrian gate
